title: Lock File Drift Checker and Version Bumper
instructions: Implement `normalize`, `parse_release`, `satisfies`, `split_requirement`, `find_drift` and `bump` in `lockdrift.py` with the standard library only. Versions compare as zero-padded integer tuples (`0.10.0 > 0.9`), pre-release strings raise `ValueError`, and `find_drift` reads `project.dependencies` plus every dependency group against a uv-style lock, returning sorted messages.

evidence.label: satisfies handles ==, !=, ranges, ~= and numeric (not lexicographic) ordering
parse_release returns integer tuples and normalize follows PEP 503
Pre-release, post-release and junk version strings raise ValueError
An unknown specifier clause raises ValueError with "unsupported specifier clause"
split_requirement drops extras and environment markers
A consistent pyproject and lock produce no drift
Reports a missing package and a locked version that violates its specifier, sorted
Checks dependency groups, skips include-group items and normalises lock names
bump follows SemVer reset rules for patch, minor and major
